mapper.select: select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m join sys_role_menu rm on rm.menu_id = m.id join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rm.role_id join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id and r.deleted = 0 and r.status = 1 where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.deleted = 0 and m.status = 1 and m.perms is not null and m.perms <> ''
